media.authority: MEDIA METADATA IS PRESENTATION/ARCHIVE DATA — NOT GENEALOGY EVIDENCE BY DEFAULT
media.privacyRule: Living-person media must be public only when explicitly marked public; media visibility never overrides living-person field redaction.

relationshipSemantics.rule: Spouse, parent-child, contextual, step/adoptive, and identity relationships remain distinct edge types and must not be visually collapsed into generic pedigree.

visualFamilyExperience.canonicalRule: v12.3 changes visual presentation and navigation only. Canonical v10 evidence, source states, rejected assertions, and unresolved identity semantics remain immutable.

mediaLibrary.privacyRule: Media linked to a living person is forced private by the server. Public visibility is allowed only for non-living people and only by explicit editor choice.
mediaLibrary.deletionRule: Media deletion is a soft-delete tombstone; binary content is retained for controlled recovery/audit until separately purged.
mediaLibrary.evidenceRule: Uploading or linking a photo/document never changes a person, relationship, claim, or evidence state.
mediaLibrary.provenanceRule: Each media record carries contributor, linked person ID, optional source ID, visibility, original filename, MIME type, and evidence-authority label.

revisionReview.rule: Pending shared revisions are compared with the preceding approved family-edit snapshot for reviewer clarity. The diff never approves, merges, or promotes anything automatically.
revisionReview.approvalRule: Approve and Reject remain explicit actions separate from the diff display.

collaborationIdentity.authentication: Server-side password verification with scrypt-derived hashes and HttpOnly SameSite session cookies.
collaborationIdentity.storage: Netlify Blobs with strong consistency in production; users, sessions, and append-only revisions are separate keyed objects.

roleRules.viewer: Read public-safe family data and approved revisions.
roleRules.researcher: Contributor rights plus research/media workflow participation.
roleRules.admin: Editor rights plus create family accounts.

collaborationIdentity.bootstrapRule: The existing FAMILY_EDITOR_WRITE_KEY may be used only to bootstrap the first administrator or as a temporary legacy migration credential. It is not the normal collaboration identity.
collaborationIdentity.attributionRule: Submitted revisions are attributed from the authenticated family account rather than free-text contributor identity.
collaborationIdentity.reviewRule: Approve/reject requires Editor or Admin role and remains an explicit review action. Revision objects carry a version field and review requests include the expected version so stale review attempts fail instead of silently overwriting a newer state.
collaborationIdentity.canonicalRule: Authentication, roles, attribution, storage, and review workflow never promote or rewrite canonical v10 evidence.

deploymentProvenance.rule: Production can be compared directly with repository HEAD using build-info.json; deployment provenance does not alter genealogy data.

familyExperienceRedesign.title: Family Experience Redesign

familyExperienceRedesign.privacyRule: Living-person dates and private media remain protected exactly as in the canonical/public-safe and media privacy layers.
